title: common
description: Shared definitions of the recording file contract v1 (docs/11-m3-design.md §7.2-§7.7). Unknown fields are always allowed; pattern follows ECMA-262 ($ matches only at the end).

monoId.description: EEEEEEE-BBBBB-SSSS in upper-case Crockford base32; same as protocol v0 common#/$defs/monoId.

attempt.description: Processing attempt. Fixed to 1 in v0.3.0; reserved for v0.3.x reruns.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit offset, e.g. 2026-10-21T14:45:10.120+08:00.

bareName.description: A file name inside the session directory: no '/', no '\\', no leading '.' (so never '.' or '..').

segFile.description: seg-NNN.wav with the segment index, zero-padded to 3 digits (4 from index 1000).

label.description: Short single-line text: no control characters.
